WITH match_stats AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(w.player_out) FILTER (WHERE w.kind_out IN ('lbw', 'caught and bowled', 'caught', 'bowled', 'hit wicket', 'stumped')) AS wickets,
        SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(b.ball_id) - COUNT(e.extra_type) FILTER (WHERE e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs')) AS balls_bowled
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored s ON b.match_id = s.match_id AND b.over_id = s.over_id AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.bowler
)

SELECT match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no, COUNT(*) FROM ipl.main.wicket_taken GROUP BY match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

WITH match_stats AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.bowler,
        COUNT(w.player_out) FILTER (WHERE w.kind_out IN ('lbw', 'caught and bowled', 'caught', 'bowled', 'hit wicket', 'stumped')) AS wickets,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.runs_scored), 0) AS runs_conceded,
        COUNT(b.ball_id) - COUNT(e.extra_type) FILTER (WHERE e.extra_type IN ('wides', 'noballs')) AS balls_bowled
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored s ON b.match_id = s.match_id AND b.over_id = s.over_id AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.wicket_taken w ON b.match_id = w.match_id AND b.over_id = w.over_id AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.bowler
),
ranked_performances AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        wickets,
        runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC) AS rn
    FROM match_stats
),
best_performances AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        CAST(wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) AS best_bowling_performance
    FROM ranked_performances
    WHERE rn = 1
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        SUM(wickets) AS total_wickets,
        SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(balls_bowled) AS total_balls_bowled,
        SUM(runs_conceded) / (SUM(balls_bowled) / 6.0) AS economy_rate,
        SUM(balls_bowled) / NULLIF(SUM(wickets), 0) AS strike_rate
    FROM match_stats
    GROUP BY bowler
)
SELECT
